purpose: Evaluate expression-adjusted ranking diagnostics on a transparent supervised perturbation predictor with held-out target identities; no assertion of method superiority or novel prediction architecture.
method_source: Ahlmann-Eltze et al., Nature Methods 2025, doi:10.1038/s41592-025-02772-6; official code commit bfa6eeea2bd145a1af2ec0127a2e808cc38456a9
target_scope: All 64 Adamson and 58 Norman targets frozen by the preceding measurement pilot. No selection by new prediction or evaluation outcomes.
fold_assignment: Sort target names by SHA256(heldout_linear_diagnostic_v1|dataset|target), break impossible hash ties by target name, assign sorted positions modulo 3. Save complete assignment before any model fit.
training_data: For each fold, reconstruct mean source X over the frozen pert_A cells for training targets only. X is the verified curated log-normalized expression, not raw counts. Never use held-out target A cells, B/C cells, or outcomes for fitting, model selection, PCA, or hyperparameter choice.
readout_genes: All source genes, in frozen responses.npz gene order, including test target genes as measured readouts under training perturbations. This does not use held-out target perturbation responses. Upstream all-cell HVG selection remains a known historical limitation.
gene_embedding: PCA equivalent to R prcomp on the gene-by-training-condition absolute pseudobulk matrix: center each condition column across genes, do not scale columns; G is U times singular values, first K columns. P consists of G rows corresponding to training targets; P_test uses held-out target gene rows.
regression: Let Y be gene-by-training-condition absolute expression, b its per-gene mean. W=solve(G.T@G+lambda*I,G.T@(Y-b))@P@inverse(P.T@P+lambda*I). Predicted post-expression is G@W@P_test.T+b. This is the published bilinear ridge architecture, not a new method.
prediction_reference: Subtract the mean source X of the existing 400 independent Dm controls from each predicted post-expression vector. Use this same Dm mean for the training-condition-mean predictor. Record control cell IDs and hash; no held-out B/C controls enter predictions.
scores: Absolute predicted expression change for raw ranking; signed OLS residual of log10(max(abs(predicted_delta),1e-10)) on independent C0 or Cq with intercept for EDR.
comparators: training-condition mean with no target-specific prediction
five training target-label permutations of the linear model
observed A-response technical anchor, evaluated only as a labeled positive anchor
permutation_semantics: Permute assignment of training target gene rows to training-condition columns when constructing P, keeping Y, b, G, test P and fold membership fixed. Report all draws, no p-value or best-draw selection.
evaluation_scope: Use identical fixed 970 Adamson / 982 Norman candidate genes, excluding all directly perturbed target genes, with frozen B and C outcomes. Cross-target mismatch sources are restricted to held-out targets from the SAME fitted fold; never mix predictions from folds that trained on a query target.
metrics: within-test-fold identity gain over the average other-target ranking
signed prediction MSE separately against B and C on the fixed candidate scope
Pearson delta correlation separately against B and C
paired differences from the same-fold training-mean predictor
Top50 fractional inclusion-weight agreement across covariate conditions
measurement_conditions: Predict once at q1. Compare raw and EDR rankings at C0 and existing Cq (q=0.5,0.25; seeds below). This is a fixed-model covariate-measurement audit, NOT a full model-input factorial and NOT directly equivalent to refitting scTenifoldKnk after count thinning.
checks: Verify registered source hashes and preserve old outputs
No duplicate target or candidate identity
Training and held-out target sets disjoint and exhaust scope
Training pert_A cells and Dm controls disjoint from B/C and from held-out target A cells
Perturbing synthetic held-out outcomes cannot change fitted predictions
Bilinear implementation agrees with an independent direct normal-equation calculation
Raw scores and evaluation invariant across C-only changes
All constant/floored/failed tasks retained and flagged
limits: New development analysis on previously inspected studies; not confirmatory
Published predictor adapted to existing split and candidate scope; not a replication of its reported benchmark numbers
Both studies use K562 and technical library partitions, not independent biological replicates
Historical HVG selection and preprocessing denominator limitations remain explicit
Fold and thinning repeats are not independent biological sample sizes
Model improvement or covariate instability is not guaranteed and is not a basis for dropping conditions
